$comment: File-risk allowlists for scripts/can-auto-merge.py in autoRefine. Split out of the script on 2026-08-18: this repo and nauroLabs-github each carried a full fork of the gate purely to express a different allowlist, and the two copies had drifted 37 lines apart. The script is now identical in both repos; this file is the only thing that differs. Keep it that way — a change belongs here, not in the script.
$semantics: low_risk decides whether the file-tier gate lets a PR merge unattended at all. high_risk decides whether Claude deep-review must APPROVE first. agent/ and scripts/ appear in both: autoRefine's source lives there, so every source change merges without a human but only after the LLM review passes, while plain docs and tests merge on CI alone.
